java_locations.role: Wraps the circled character in its fixed margins and passes it with the stereotype and name blocks to HeaderLayout.
Measures the complete header from circle, stereotype, name, and generic blocks, then vertically centers the complete circled-character block with yCircle = (height - circleDim.height) / 2.
Draws the ellipse and centered glyph symmetrically inside the raw circled-character dimension.

rust_locations.role: Already measures the Java-shaped header but bypasses that measurement for stereotyped entities and instead places every icon from the truncated literal 20.3105.

claimed_invariant: HeaderLayout vertically centers the complete circled-character block inside the complete measured class header. Because the raw CircledCharacter ellipse is centered within its symmetric wrapped block, the emitted ellipse and glyph center is entity_y + header_height / 2. The same ownership applies whether the header height is driven by one or many stereotype rows, a multiline name, font changes, padding, or the circle itself.
causal_divergence: Rust computes the full class header height but ignores it when dim.has_stereotypes, using the corpus-derived literal 20.3105 instead. For the default one-stereotype header, Java's measured height is 40.62109375 and its center is 20.310546875. The truncated Rust center formats identically for the ellipse but moves enough glyph outline coordinates across four-place rounding boundaries to leave the G and U path residuals.
planned_model_change: Remove the stereotyped-only icon center literal and always center a visible circled-character block from class_header_height, using entity_y + measured_header_height / 2. Preserve oracle overrides and the existing no-stereotype formula's equivalent result. Do not add per-character, label, or fixture conditions.

checked_derivations.derivation: The expected and Rust ellipse both format cy=27.3105 at entity_y=7, while only glyph y coordinates near four-place boundaries differ. Java HeaderLayout's one-stereotype header height is the measured stereotype, name, and 10px envelope; centering it yields an internal center with more precision than the emitted ellipse attribute exposes.

Every x coordinate and the complete command topology agree, while affected y coordinates are consistently one final decimal below Java. The same measured header center drives U independently of its outline, so a header-composition fix explains both letters without glyph-specific data.

perturbation_axes: one through three visible stereotype rows
short, long, and multiline class names
default and changed class/circled-character font sizes
custom G, U, W, and lowercase spot characters
one-leaf and linked SVEK body lifecycles
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns vertical centering of class circled-character blocks inside measured stereotyped headers. It does not own glyph outlines, UnusedSpace centers, horizontal header placement, SVEK entity positions, stereotype parsing or colors, comparator tolerance, or corpus eligibility.
acceptance: Both evidence inputs become structurally equivalent without oracle data.
Existing default and custom spot controls without visible stereotype text do not regress.
Fresh renamed inputs cover changed stereotype count and multiline header height.
The full no-oracle ratchet does not regress any family.
Renderer tests, clippy, and the four frozen mechanical guards pass except for explicitly pre-existing gate debt.
An independent checker records a verdict at the exact implementation revision.
